conflicts.title: Frequency conflicts
conflicts.explanation: Frequencies within {{kilohertz}} kHz with the same modulation (AM/FM) are counted as conflicts.
conflicts.scope: In creator view, the frequencies of both sides are compared together. The pre-distribution check L1 compares each side separately, so conflicts across sides appear here but not in L1.

types.same-aircraft-preset: The same frequency on another channel of the same aircraft
types.different-flight: The same frequency as another flight
types.support: The same frequency as a support asset

empty.title: No frequencies
empty.body: No flight has radio presets, and no support asset has a frequency.

navaid.title: Support TACAN and ICLS
navaid.none: No support asset has a TACAN or ICLS

atc.title: Air traffic control (ATC)
atc.notRecorded: ATC frequencies are not recorded. Airbase control frequencies are not shown on this screen.
